config.name: B0 old plan Stage A
config.notes: Archetype base rate + market-price slope (fit on train); trade when edge > 5c net; spread <= 10c; refuse <3c.

config.name: V01 market price only
config.notes: Sanity row: the market as its own forecast. Brier skill must be 0 and no trades.

config.name: V02 global Platt (no archetype)
config.notes: Drop the archetype intercepts; one recalibration curve for all markets.

config.name: V03 archetype slope too
config.notes: Archetype-specific slope as well as intercept.

config.name: V04 isotonic recalibration
config.notes: Non-parametric calibration of mid.

config.name: V05 paper FLB prior (no fit)
config.notes: Burgi et al. Table 8 politics coefficients applied as-is.

config.name: V06 microstructure logistic
config.notes: Adds spread, volume, OI, age, 7d drift, field size.

config.name: V07 reversion term
config.notes: Adds last week's mid change (tests momentum vs mean reversion).

config.name: V08 blend with market
config.notes: w*old_plan + (1-w)*market, w picked on a validation tail inside train.

config.name: V09 sum-to-one normalisation
config.notes: Normalise exclusive fields to sum 1 before recalibrating.

config.name: V10 recency: last 365d of train
config.notes: Fit only on the most recent year of train (bias may be fading, Burgi Table 9).

config.name: V11 min_edge 2c
config.notes: Lower trade threshold.

config.name: V12 min_edge 10c
config.notes: Higher trade threshold.

config.name: V13 edge in logit space
config.notes: Require 0.25 logit units of edge instead of cents.

config.name: V14 YES side only
config.notes: Only buy YES.

config.name: V15 NO side only
config.notes: Only buy NO (longshot-fade direction).

config.name: V16 favourites only (>=50c)
config.notes: Entry price >= 50c.

config.name: V17 tails excluded (15-85c)
config.notes: Trade only the middle of the price range.

config.name: V18 tight books only (spread<=4c)
config.notes: Universe filter.

config.name: V19 mature markets (age>=30d)
config.notes: Universe filter.

config.name: V20 maker execution
config.notes: Join the best bid; filled only if price trades through within a week; no maker fee on political series (verified on API).

config.name: V21 low-sophistication markets
config.notes: Bottom tercile of the composite sophistication score (train cut points).

config.name: V22 mid-sophistication markets
config.notes: Middle tercile.

config.name: V23 high-sophistication markets
config.notes: Top tercile.

config.name: V24 zero-fee counterfactual
config.notes: Not tradeable; shows how much of the result the fee decides.

config.name: V25 knowledge-file prior
config.notes: Adds the best retrieved base-rate line (as_of < T) as a logit feature: does the knowledge layer earn its place?
